SOC 47-2152

Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters by metro

Among Austin, Chicago, and Seattle, Plumbers, Pipefitters, and Steamfitters have a published OEWS May 2025 annual median of $103,380 in Chicago, the highest in this slice. Published medians: Chicago $103,380, Seattle $95,230, Austin $62,810.

Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. bls.gov/oes. These figures are informational republications of BLS OEWS. They are not legal, career, or hiring advice.
